name: notch

frames.best_why: The Theme panel is fully open with Dark highlighted in blue, while the bar underneath still shows every value.

tagline: A small floating pill holds theme, text and language pickers that pop open.
summary: A capsule pinned near the screen edge with grouped settings; each group opens into a short list of choices and the bar shows the current value for every group.
appearance: A dark rounded capsule floats low on a near-black article page, split by dotted dividers into three items, each with a small icon plus a label and current value. Opening one raises a narrow panel of rounded option rows.
behaviour: Tapping a group expands the pill upward into a list with a spring and blur, the active row filled indigo with a dot. Choosing closes it and updates the bar; clicking outside or pressing Escape dismisses it.
demo_content: An article titled 'Designing calm interfaces for people who read on the train' with Theme, Text and Language settings.
search_phrases: floating settings bar at the bottom
small menu that drops from a pill
reader settings for font size and theme
use_when: A reading app or dashboard needs a few global settings always reachable without a full menu.
avoid_when: It pins over page content, so on small screens it can cover text unless you leave room at the edge.
customise: Feed an items array of groups and options, and set position, align, offset, accentColor, showSelectedValue, showDividers and closeOnSelect; styling is in the source.
weight_why: A small fixed bar with one layout spring and short option animations.

a11y.note: Triggers always report aria-expanded false even when open, and there is no focus ring or arrow-key handling.

issues: The trigger hardcodes aria-expanded to false, so screen readers never hear that a panel opened.
polish_why: Tidy glass capsule with a confident spring; the blur transition looks rough mid-flight.
title: Notch
